Required framework\n\nA framework essential for the HSK modpack.
Compatible framework\n\nA third-party framework tested for compatibility with HSK.
Required HSK mod\n\nIncluded in HSK and critical to the game.
Optional HSK mod\n\nIncluded in the default HSK modpack, but optional.
Optional HSK mod (in testing)\n\nIncluded in HSK, optional, and currently being tested.
Native HSK addon\n\nA third-party mod made specifically for HSK.
Converted HSK addon\n\nAn existing mod adapted to work with HSK.
Workshop mod — fully compatible\n\nTested and fully compatible with HSK.
Workshop mod — partially compatible\n\nRequires modifications, balancing, or conversion to work with HSK.
Workshop mod — incompatible\n\nTested and known to break the game when used with HSK.
Unknown compatibility\n\nCompatibility with HSK is unknown. This is the default for unclassified mods.
Patch\n\nA single patch or a small set of patches.
Patch collection\n\nA large collection of patches.
Load last\n\nThese mods belong at the end of the load order. Do not place other mods below them.
